paper_metadata.title: Significantly Improving the High-Temperature Tensile Properties of Al17Cr10Fe36Ni36Mo1 Alloys by Microalloying Hf

evidence.quote: Dual-phase high-entropy alloys with excellent room temperature and high-temperature properties have been widely studied as potential high-temperature structural materials.

Alloys with a nominal composition of All7Cr10Fe36-xNi36Mo1Hfx (at%) were prepared by arc-melting high-purity raw metals (>99.9 wt%) in a Ti-gettered high-purity Ar atmosphere. When the values of x are 0, 0.03, 0.15, 0.3, 0.5, and 0.8, alloys are denoted as Hf0, Hf0.03, Hf0.15, Hf0.3, Hf0.5, and Hf0.8, respectively.

parameters.cooling_method: rapid drop into water-cooled copper mold

evidence.quote: Alloys with a nominal composition of All7Cr10Fe36-xNi36Mo1Hfx (at%) were prepared by arc-melting high-purity raw metals (>99.9 wt%) in a Ti-gettered high-purity Ar atmosphere.
The ﬁve as-cast ingots were homogenized at 1200 ◦C for 8 h to reduce solute segregation.
For the PSR process, the homogenized alloy was cold-rolled by 15% and crystallized at 1200 ◦C for 20 min for two cycles
For the PSR process, the homogenized alloy was cold-rolled by 15% and crystallized at 1200 ◦C for 20 min for two cycles
followed by 30% cold-rolling and crystallized at 1200 ◦C for 20 min
followed by 30% cold-rolling and crystallized at 1200 ◦C for 20 min
Finally, the ﬁve PSR alloys were aged at 700 ◦C for 12 h. Air cooling was adopted in all the heat treatment procedures to avoid cracks.
Based on previous investigations [36,37], the region enriched in Ni and Al was the B2 phase, while the phase enriched in Fe and Cr was the FCC phase.

evidence.quote: According to the EDS proﬁle in Figure 3a, it can be inferred that the spherical precipitates enriched in Fe, Cr, and Mo are BCC phases, while the matrix phase enriched in Ni and Al is the B2 phase [36].

it can be inferred that these needle-like structures precipitated in the matrix were the L1 2 phases and that the matrix was the FCC phase. These needle-shaped structures were mainly composed of Ni and Al
